selected_branches.branch: Opposite-side destination stopping under the 75-foot clause.

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 20 feet of a driveway entrance to any fire station and, on the side of a highway opposite the entrance to any fire station, within 75 feet of that entrance.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 20 feet of a driveway entrance to any fire station and, on the side of a highway opposite the entrance to any fire station, within 75 feet of that entrance.

runtime_uncertainties: Original CARLA entrance, station identity and public-highway basis require local review.
Measured body distances do not settle a legal distance convention.
Exception necessity and official authority require independent legal review.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: Original fire-station entrance and public-highway source evidence
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen inventory contains no accepted original recording for the 20-foot and opposite-side 75-foot clauses.

witness_review.branch: Opposite-side destination stopping under the 75-foot clause.
required_context: Construct the opposite-side stopping destination and retain vehicle extent and raw entrance geometry around the express 75-foot quantity.
Establish fire-station identity, driveway entrance and independent stopping destination.
Establish the person's conduct and the device's qualifying vehicle characteristics.
Record actual activity and all exception circumstances without selecting a statutory distance convention.
Retain raw entrance/vehicle geometry near the 75-foot quantity, activity and all exception circumstances.
Supply actual fire-station identity, entrance geometry, highway boundaries, public dedication and public vehicular use.
Supply highway boundaries, public-authority dedication and public vehicular use, and locate ego on the opposite side.
witness_review.reason: The destination halt can be placed on the highway side opposite the fixed entrance.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: NRS 484B.450(1)(j) fire-station driveway entrance, 20/75-foot placements and stated exceptions
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted recordings; fifteen source-gated exact captures required.
